Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars
We are not just building a website to display space technology. We are creating a bridge between complex scientific information and curious minds through AI, interactive 3D models, educational videos, and simplified scientific content.

 Beyond the Mission brings multiple learning tools into one platform, turning space exploration from something people simply read about into something they can actively explore and understand
details:
Beyond the Mission

Beyond the Mission is an interactive educational platform designed to make space exploration more accessible, interesting, and easier to understand for students and science enthusiasts.

Our project focuses on exploring the scientific missions sent to the Moon and Mars. It presents information about different spacecraft, scientific instruments, and experiments in a simple and interactive way. Users can explore missions, understand the purpose of each instrument, discover what scientific data it collected, and learn how these discoveries contributed to our understanding of space.

The platform helps solve the gap between the huge amount of scientific information available and the difficulty students face when trying to understand it. Instead of reading complicated scientific reports, users can explore organized content through a user-friendly website and visual explanations.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

Our project makes space science easier to access and understand, encourages students to learn about science and technology, and increases awareness of past and present space exploration missions. We aim to turn complex scientific knowledge into an engaging learning experience and inspire more students to become interested in STEM fields.

Tools and Technologies:

We developed our project as a web-based platform using web development technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, to build the interface and interactive features. We also used scientific information and mission data from NASA resources to ensure that the educational content is based on reliable information.

Creativity and Innovation:

What makes Beyond the Mission creative is its focus on the scientific side of space missions, not just the spacecraft themselves. We connect spacecraft, scientific instruments, experiments, and their discoveries in one educational experience. This allows users to understand not only what happened during a mission, but also why it mattered scientifically.

Factors Considered:

During development, our team considered scientific accuracy, ease of use, accessibility for students, visual design, and the organization of information. We also focused on presenting complex scientific concepts in a simple way while keeping the content interesting, reliable, and educational.
